If the raw value for a boolean-valued property is not a boolean,
warn and discard the value.

If the invalid raw is the only value for the property, as in this test,
discard the property.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            # living is a boolean property.
            living: "string instead of bool"

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.living: property value discarded: expected boolean, got string

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties: {}
